docs.summary: Per-import configuration. Construct directly with object-initializer syntax, or start from [`GameQuality`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Importer.ModelImporterSettings~GameQuality)/[`GameFast`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Importer.ModelImporterSettings~GameFast)/[`EditorMaxQuality`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Importer.ModelImporterSettings~EditorMaxQuality)/[`Raw`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Importer.ModelImporterSettings~Raw).
Bit mask of post-process steps to run.
Maximum smoothing angle (in degrees) used by `GenerateSmoothNormals`.

When true, the `GenerateNormals` / `GenerateSmoothNormals` steps replace normals the source already supplied instead of leaving them alone. Off by default: a source that shipped normals knows its own smoothing groups, and rebuilding them from geometry discards that.

Maximum number of bone weights kept per vertex by `LimitBoneWeights`. Values above [`MaxInfluences`](#api~Prowl.Clay.BoneWeight~MaxInfluences) are honoured through the pipeline but not in the baked [`Model`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Model), whose vertex layout holds four; the bake keeps the strongest four, renormalises them, and says so in the log.
Uniform scale applied by `GlobalScale` (defaults to 1.0 = no scaling).
Maximum vertices per mesh enforced by `SplitLargeMeshes`.
When true (and the `ValidateDataStructure` step is enabled), validator warnings are promoted to [`ImportException`](#api~Prowl.Clay.ImportException).
Index of the scene to import from a file that defines several, or -1 for the one the file nominates as its default. Out-of-range values fall back to the default with a warning.
Names of nodes the `OptimizeGraph` step must never collapse.
Sink invoked for every [`ImportLogEntry`](#api~Prowl.Clay.ImportLogEntry) as it is emitted.
Default game-engine preset (recommended for runtime imports).
Maximum-quality editor preset (slower, runs validators + optimizers).
